faq.question: What is KPV?
faq.answer: KPV is the tripeptide Lys-Pro-Val (CAS 67727-97-3), the C-terminal fragment of α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, used as a research reagent in inflammation-pathway studies.

faq.question: How does KPV differ from full-length α-MSH?
faq.answer: KPV is a three-residue fragment rather than the full hormone, and research focuses on its inflammatory-signalling profile rather than the pigmentation-associated melanocortin activity of the intact peptide.

faq.question: What kit configurations are available?
faq.answer: 5 mg and 10 mg × 10-vial kits, plus custom vial sizes for OEM and protocol-specific work.

faq.question: Which documentation is supplied?
faq.answer: A batch-specific COA with HPLC purity and MS identity, plus invoice and packing list. Full chromatograms on request.
